snippet.title: Game Soundtrack Replacements Pro Mahjong Kiwame GB ~ Ide Yousuke no Mahjong Kyoushitsu GB Non-SGB 2
snippet.description:
Continuing with more videogame soundtrack importing into other games, this time it is a replacement of Pro Mahjong Kiwame GB using the Ide Yousuke no Mahjong Kyoushitsu soundtrack with the instrument settings from Pro Mahjong Kiwame GB, which is an earlier version of the sound driver that is compatible. Part 2 will consist of the Mogura de Pon, or alternate soundtrack mode, so there is a different selection of songs.
